hero.subtitle: Price, financials, industry, news, rates — we pull scattered data into a single analysis report. All you do is enter a ticker.

features.title: Three lenses on a single stock
features.sub: Price alone doesn't tell the story. Qaima analyzes a stock through three lenses: the company itself, its environment, and your portfolio.

deep.title: Deep Analysis
deep.desc: AI sums up a single stock's price flow and financials in one pass — entry/exit signals, valuation read, key risks.

external.title: External Factors
external.desc: Industry index, rates, news, short selling, peer stocks — every external factor around a stock in one view.

portfolio.title: Portfolio
portfolio.desc: Enter your holdings and get a risk, diversification, and efficiency check — plus rebalancing tuned to your risk profile.

workflow.title: One search, 30-second analysis
workflow.sub: No setup. Type the ticker, and AI assembles the report from scattered data.

step1.title: Search
step1.desc: Name, code, or ticker — Korean and US markets are both supported.

step2.title: AI Analysis
step2.desc: Gemini · GPT-based LLMs read price, financials, news, industry, and rate data together.

step3.title: Insight
step3.desc: Not raw numbers, but the "why". Save the report to PDF and take it with you.

sources.title: From official sources, in real time
sources.sub: Not blog summaries. We pull primary data from exchanges, central banks, and disclosure systems.

macro.label: Macro indicators
macro.note: Base rate, FX rate, treasury yields

news.label: News & disclosures
news.note: Includes short selling and foreign-investor flows
